cards.meaning: bail (money posted so an accused can be free during trial)
cards.example: Magsisimula ang pagdinig sa petisyon para sa piyansa ni dating Speaker Romualdez.
cards.exampleMeaning: The hearing on former Speaker Romualdez's bail petition begins.
cards.note: Pormal ngunit pang-araw-araw na rin sa balita. Kaugnay: maglagak ng piyansa, piyansahan, pampiyansa. Sa plunder, hindi basta nakakapagpiyansa.
cards.tiesTo: Romualdez plunder bail hearings at the Sandiganbayan

cards.meaning: inference, conclusion drawn from signs without direct proof
cards.example: Ang hinuha ng prosekusyon, may itinatagong yaman sa mga account.
cards.exampleMeaning: The prosecution's inference is that wealth is hidden in the accounts.
cards.note: Mas may batayan kaysa 'hula', mas mahina kaysa katiyakan. Pormal: 'makatwirang hinuha'. Sa kolokyal na usapan: 'sa tingin ko'.
cards.tiesTo: Bank witnesses at the Sara Duterte impeachment trial

cards.meaning: so much so that (connective introducing an extreme result)
cards.example: 价格战打得太久，以至于企业的利润几乎消失了。
cards.examplePinyin: Jiàgé zhàn dǎ de tài jiǔ, yǐzhìyú qǐyè de lìrùn jīhū xiāoshī le.
cards.exampleMeaning: The price war has gone on so long that corporate profits have nearly vanished.
cards.note: 书面语/neutral. Contrast 以致 (result usually negative); 以至于 is neutral and follows a degree/duration expression (太…, 那么…).
cards.tiesTo: EU-China trade-remedy tit-for-tat after a long price war

cards.meaning: to depend on, to be determined by
cards.example: 谈判能否取得进展，取决于双方是否愿意让步。
cards.examplePinyin: Tánpàn néngfǒu qǔdé jìnzhǎn, qǔjuéyú shuāngfāng shìfǒu yuànyì ràngbù.
cards.exampleMeaning: Whether the talks make progress depends on whether both sides are willing to give ground.
cards.note: Formal/neutral collocation, pairs with 能否/是否. Colloquial near-synonym 看…而定. Contrast 决定 (verb; the deciding factor is the subject).
